row.name: Force Crush
row.effect: Victim suffers 1d crushing (cr) damage to a specific limb.

levels.name: Force Crush
levels.description: A Force wielder uses the Dark Side to telekinetically crush an opponent, or specific part of an opponent. Requires a Quick Contest of Force Skill (Will) vs target's HT or Will. Win by 3+: choose location. Win by 5+: double damage. Failure: mental stun for 1 turn. Crit Fail: you take 1d6 cr and are physically stunned for 1d turns.
levels.effect: Victim suffers 1d crushing (cr) damage to a specific limb.
